name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: U.S. Diesel Prices Set New High
changes.summary: Because of the war in Iran, the cost has climbed past the record it reached in 2022 after Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

changes.title: More severe weather set to slam parts of U.S.
changes.summary: More severe weather is expected after storms hit parts of Pennsylvania, Indiana and Ohio. CBS News' Lana Zak reports.

changes.title: New jobs numbers surprise economists
changes.summary: The latest data shows the U.S. added 162,000 jobs in August, beating expectations after a disappointing July report. CBS News' Emily Pandise reports.

changes.title: August jobs report shows U.S. added 162,000 jobs, blowing past forecasts
changes.summary: Strong hiring last month was driven by gains in education and in leisure and hospitality, with the nation's jobless rate remaining steady at 4.1%.

changes.title: Serena and Venus Williams returning to U.S. Open women's doubles tournament together tonight
changes.summary: Serena and Venus Williams will play together at the U.S. Open in New York for the first time in four years.

changes.title: What app surged in downloads after Trump's 'Lake America' change? The quiz knows
changes.summary: Plus: George Santos is back in the news!

changes.title: Hiring burst of 162,000 jobs in August puts the focus squarely back on inflation in the U.S.
changes.summary: The U.S. job market rebounded in August as employers added a surprising 162,000 jobs. The unemployment rate stayed at a low 4.1%.

changes.title: Can a ‘Prairie Populist’ Democrat Win a Senate Seat in Trump’s Iowa?
changes.summary: Josh Turek is trying to turn deep-red Iowa blue as he runs for the U.S. Senate.

changes.title: A More Confident Iran Emerges After Six Months of War With the U.S.
changes.summary: New intelligence reports have assessed that Iran now has a far better understanding of its capabilities and the limits of U.S. power.

changes.title: The U.S. Wants the Oil From These 17 Venezuelan Fields
changes.summary: A private oil company has struck a deal with the Trump administration to develop 17 areas in Venezuela, an effort that experts say will take years and billions of dollars.
